name: card-grid
description: Card grid — team, portfolio, service or case list, one card per item the brief gives; with none, the band does not draw. panel.card is a CONTAINER (it has no heading/text props); content goes in as children.
provenPattern: A survey of 54 sector demo homepages: this band appears in 24 of them, mean vertical position 0.51 (0 = top of page, 1 = bottom). The surveyed sites add a hover/caption layer; this pattern has none yet, the arrangement is equivalent

knowledge.purpose: Page band presenting a team, portfolio, service or case list as a card grid
useCases: Introducing a service list with image + heading + short text
Showing team members in a grid
antiPatterns: Trying to give the card block heading/text props — card is a CONTAINER; content goes in as children
Leaving a card count that does not divide by the grid columns — a lone card on the last row breaks the balance
Leaving card images without alt text
A second card-grid band on the same page — repetition makes monotony, not rhythm
Inventing members, services or cases to fill the grid — draw only the items the brief gives
A card with an href and no cta text, or cta text with no href — the link needs both a destination and words
Expecting it to list the app's own records — its cards are the brief's fixed content; a list of the app's records is a data-bound band
Alt text that repeats the card title — when the picture only illustrates the title next to it, its alt is ""
A centred band heading over left-aligned cards on a page whose other headings start at the left edge — one left edge

mobileCollapse: The grid collapses to single-column cards.

placeholders.{{CARDS}}: array of {image, alt, title, text, href?, cta?} — exactly the team members, services or cases the brief gives, in its words; image is a URL or "" for none; alt says what the picture shows, or "" when it only illustrates the title beside it; href (root-relative, e.g. /services/audit) and cta (the link text, e.g. Read the case) only when the card leads somewhere — a card without href draws no link; [] for none. Never invent an entry to reach a count.

{{TITLE_SIZE}}.description: the size of the card titles, as a theme size step: xl, lg or base — e.g. lg when the page already has larger headings above the cards and the h3 default would compete with them. Empty (""): the theme’s h3 size
